name: Alice-chanchi ni Isourou!
original_name: アリスちゃんちに居候っ!
source:
Having somehow strayed into the demonic realm, you've got to stay at little Al*ce's house.
A novel game where you enjoy lovey-dovey with not only alice but alto Sh*nki-sama and Y*meko-chan!
